mechanism_narrative: Higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) levels compress equity valuations through increased discount rates, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns when FEDFUNDS is above 4.5%.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is above 4.5%, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in CPIAUCSL above 0.1 points signals potential monetary tightening, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL rises > 0.1 in 1 month, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) and inflation (CPIAUCSL > 202.0) signal a high-stress monetary environment, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 4.5 and CPIAUCSL > 202.0, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), strong labor market conditions support corporate earnings growth, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 4.0, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Falling housing starts (HOUST < 1800.0) signal a weakening housing market, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1800.0, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) levels indicate robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns when INDPRO is above 110.0.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is above 110.0, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Falling residential sales (RSAFS < 360000.0) signal a weakening housing market, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: When RSAFS < 360000.0, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) levels compress equity valuations over the medium term, leading to negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns when FEDFUNDS is above 4.5%.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is above 4.5%, 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
